                              Module registry

                              Every module available in the Praxion HROS platform. Enable or disable per tenant from the tenant detail drawer.

                              Platform settings

                              Global controls that apply to every tenant. Changes here affect the entire fleet.

                              Feature flags

                              Flip these on to expose new features to every tenant. For per-tenant rollouts, use the tenant drawer.

                                Module entitlements

                                Default matrix — which modules come bundled with each subscription plan. Tenants can override in their contract.

                                System banner

                                Surface a site-wide message (maintenance window, incident, policy change). Visible to every tenant user.

                                Data retention

                                Days a record stays in hot storage before archive. Applies to audit events, terminated-employee records, and file uploads.
